name: player
title: NBA player
description: An NBA player card for json-render chats: players this season, one row each in one table, with photo, number, name, height, age and experience, points, assists, rebounds and steals per game, and each player's team now, on Fluid Functionalism's Table. Shows one player or compares several. With its API route in front of ESPN's public rosters and stats.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   PlayerCard: playerCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: PlayerCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LivePlayerCard players={props.players} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     PlayerCard: playerLookup

Players load from /api/player (installed at app/api/player/route.ts), backed by ESPN's public site API. No API key needed.
